Activity 6: Common errors

Aims

To review common grammar and vocabulary errors and to encourage learners to proofread their
written work.

Level

Adaptable from A2 to C2.

Preparation

Prepare a list of ten sentences taken from the learners’ written tasks (this can be done on a worksheet, on
the board or by using the True/False question option in Kahoot). Include a mix of sentences with common
errors and sentences with good use of grammar or vocabulary. Divide your class into teams of 3 or 4.

Step 1

Give the learners some time to decide which sentences are correct and which are wrong. They can earn
bonus points by correcting the wrong sentences.
Tip: You can also use the lesson to highlight common collocations e.g. take / pass / fail an exam.

Step 2

Feedback – check the answers as a class and give teams a point for identifying an error and a point for
correcting a sentence.
Congratulate the winning team.

Step 3

Return learners’ written work without your feedback. Learners check their work to see if they can spot
whether they have made any of the common errors discussed in class. They should now be able to
correct these.
Feedback: remind learners to leave a few minutes in the exam to check their written work, this is an
important exam strategy.
